mapper.sql: o.id AS id, o.order_key AS orderKey, o.company_seq AS companySeq, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, o.status AS status, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "order" (order_key, company_seq, total_price, delivery_date, status) VALUES (#{orderKey}, #{companySeq}, #{totalPrice}, #{deliveryDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM "order" AS o WHERE o.order_key = #{orderKey} FOR UPDATE
